title: Wonders of Bhutan with a Paro Excursion
alt: Taktsang monastery on the cliff above the Paro valley
transport: Private vehicle, driver and licensed guide throughout

program.name: Phuentsholing
program.description: Time in the border town where Bhutan begins, with the Bhutan Gate and Kharbandi above the plains.

stops.name: Thimphu

program.name: Thimphu

program.name: Punakha

activities.name: Paro sightseeing tour
activities.match: Paro Sightseeing Tour on a Private basis
activities.description: A guided round of the valley with the National Museum, Rinpung Dzong and the ruins of Drukgyel Dzong.

activities.name: Hike to the Tiger's Nest
activities.match: Tigers Nest Hiking | Bhutan on a Private basis
activities.description: The climb to Taktsang, the monastery wedged into a cliff nine hundred metres above the Paro valley floor.

program.name: Paro
program.description: Days in the valley below Taktsang, with Rinpung Dzong, the National Museum and the Tiger’s Nest hike.

1: Arrival at Bagdogra or Siliguri and transfer to Phuentsholing
Border formalities at the Bhutan Gate
Check in and the rest of the day free
2: Breakfast, then north into the hills towards Thimphu
The Chukha dam and the Wang Chhu gorge on the way
The Memorial Chorten and the Buddha Dordenma
3: Breakfast, then east over the Dochula pass
The hundred and eight chortens at the top
Punakha Dzong between the Pho and Mo rivers
The long suspension bridge over the water
4: Breakfast, then west down the valley to Paro
Terraced fields and farmhouses the whole way
The National Museum in the old watchtower
Rinpung Dzong and the Drukgyel ruins
5: Breakfast, then out into the Paro valley
The climb up the pine slope to Taktsang
The monastery wedged into the cliff face
6: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Border formalities and transfer to Siliguri

expert.name: Tenzin
expert.quote: Four valleys in five nights, overland from Siliguri. You see the whole west of the country without a single internal flight.
expert.tip: Do the Tiger’s Nest on day five rather than earlier. By then you have been at altitude for three days and the climb feels half as hard.

summary: 6 days through Phuentsholing, Thimphu, Punakha, Paro, with 5 nights, Breakfast and dinner each day and a licensed Bhutanese guide: the thimphu sightseeing with simtokha dzong, the punakha sightseeing tour, the paro sightseeing tour, the hike to the tiger's nest.
included: Included: 5 nights across Phuentsholing, Thimphu, Punakha, Paro with Breakfast and dinner each day; all land transfers by private vehicle; the Thimphu sightseeing with Simtokha Dzong; the Punakha sightseeing tour; the Paro sightseeing tour; the Hike to the Tiger's Nest; a licensed Bhutanese guide; permits and the sustainable development fee as quoted.
not_included: Not included: international and domestic flights; lunches and any meals not listed; monument entrance fees where not stated; travel insurance; personal expenses.
